senses.en: to stop or slow down a process
senses.pattern: arrest the decline / arrest the spread of a disease / arrest the development of
senses.example: Doctors hope the new treatment can [[arrest]] the spread of the infection before it reaches the lungs.
senses.example_zh: 醫生希望新療法能在感染蔓延到肺部之前抑制其擴散。

senses.en: to catch and hold someone's attention
senses.pattern: arrest sb's attention / arrest the eye / arrest sb's gaze
senses.example: A huge painting of a blue whale [[arrested]] the attention of everyone entering the museum hall.
senses.example_zh: 一幅巨大的藍鯨畫作吸引了所有走進博物館大廳的人的注意。

senses.en: to smile very happily
senses.pattern: beam with pride / beam at sb / beam with joy
senses.example: The little girl [[beamed]] with pride when her painting was hung in the school hallway.
senses.example_zh: 小女孩的畫被掛在學校走廊時，她驕傲得笑容滿面。

senses.en: a long heavy piece of wood or metal supporting a roof
senses.pattern: a wooden beam / a steel beam / roof beams
senses.example: Workers replaced the cracked wooden [[beams]] so that the old temple roof would not fall in.
senses.example_zh: 工人換掉了龜裂的木頭橫梁，以免古廟的屋頂塌下來。

gsat.sentence: She would [[beam]] and put it in her best crystal vase.
Placed along the rear or front walls of a house, house poles also helped to support the main [[beam]] of the roof.

senses.en: angry and unhappy because of unfair treatment
senses.pattern: feel bitter about sth / be bitter toward sb / grow bitter
senses.example: He still feels [[bitter]] about being blamed for a mistake that his teammate had made.
senses.example_zh: 隊友犯的錯卻怪到他頭上，他至今仍憤恨不平。
senses.note: a bitter dispute 指「激烈的爭執」

senses.en: extremely and unpleasantly cold
senses.pattern: bitter cold / a bitter wind / a bitter winter
senses.example: Hikers were warned to wear thick coats against the [[bitter]] wind on the mountain top.
senses.example_zh: 登山客被提醒要穿厚外套，以抵擋山頂刺骨的寒風。

senses.en: to give a vote in an election
senses.pattern: cast a vote / cast a ballot / cast one's vote for sb
senses.example: More than two thousand students [[cast]] their votes in this year's student council election.
senses.example_zh: 兩千多名學生在今年的學生會選舉中投了票。

senses.en: to throw light, shadow, or doubt on something
senses.pattern: cast a shadow / cast doubt on / cast light on / cast a glance at
senses.example: The tall trees along the river [[cast]] long shadows across the path in the late afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 傍晚時分，河邊的高大樹木在小徑上投射出長長的影子。

senses.en: a hard cover that protects a broken bone
senses.pattern: in a cast / wear a cast / a plaster cast
senses.example: After falling off his bike, Kevin had to wear a [[cast]] on his left arm for six weeks.
senses.example_zh: 凱文從腳踏車上摔下來後，左手臂必須打六個星期的石膏。

senses.en: most important; having the main influence
senses.pattern: play a central role / be central to / a central theme / the central issue
senses.example: Trust between teachers and students is [[central]] to the success of any school program.
senses.example_zh: 師生之間的信任，是任何學校計畫能否成功的核心關鍵。

senses.en: to publicly support or fight for a cause
senses.pattern: champion a cause / champion the rights of / champion reform
senses.example: Several famous athletes have [[championed]] the campaign to bring free sports lessons to rural schools.
senses.example_zh: 好幾位知名運動員公開擁護這項為偏鄉學校提供免費體育課的活動。

senses.en: a person who fights for a cause or group
senses.pattern: a champion of human rights / a champion of the poor / a champion of equal rights
senses.example: The writer was known as a [[champion]] of the poor and often spoke out against unfair laws.
senses.example_zh: 這位作家以窮人的擁護者聞名，經常挺身反對不公平的法律。
senses.note: 常用 a champion of＋理念／群體

senses.en: a comfortable bus for long journeys
senses.pattern: a coach tour / travel by coach / a coach station / a coach trip
senses.example: We toured Scotland by [[coach]], stopping at old castles and small fishing villages along the way.
senses.example_zh: 我們搭遊覽車遊蘇格蘭，沿途在古堡和小漁村停留。
senses.note: 英式用法；美式多說 bus

senses.en: the cheapest class of seats on a plane or train
senses.pattern: fly coach / a coach seat / a coach ticket / travel in coach
senses.example: To save money, the whole family flew [[coach]] and spent the difference on a nicer hotel.
senses.example_zh: 為了省錢，全家人都搭經濟艙，把省下來的錢拿去住好一點的飯店。

senses.en: a tall machine used for lifting heavy things
senses.pattern: a construction crane / a tower crane / operate a crane / lift by crane
senses.example: A huge [[crane]] lifted the steel beams onto the roof of the new stadium.
senses.example_zh: 一台巨大的起重機把鋼梁吊到新體育場的屋頂上。
senses.note: 因外形像鶴的長頸而得名

senses.en: to stretch your neck to see something better
senses.pattern: crane one's neck / crane one's neck to see / crane one's neck for a better view
senses.example: Fans at the back [[craned]] their necks to catch a glimpse of the singer on stage.
senses.example_zh: 後排的歌迷伸長脖子，想看一眼舞台上的歌手。

senses.en: to cut off the edges of a picture
senses.pattern: crop a photo / crop an image / crop sb out of the picture
senses.example: She [[cropped]] the photo so that the strangers in the background could not be seen.
senses.example_zh: 她裁切了照片，好讓背景裡的陌生人不被看到。
senses.note: crop up 指（問題）突然出現

senses.en: a group of people or things appearing together
senses.pattern: a new crop of / this year's crop of / a crop of young players
senses.example: This year's [[crop]] of first-year students seems more interested in coding than in sports.
senses.example_zh: 今年這一批新生似乎對寫程式比對運動更有興趣。

gsat.sentence: He made clear his dislike of images that had been improved by artificial light, darkroom effects, and even [[cropping]].

senses.en: to officially make someone a champion, king, or queen
senses.pattern: be crowned champion / be crowned king / be crowned the winner
senses.example: After beating the defending champions in the final, our school team was [[crowned]] national champion.
senses.example_zh: 在決賽擊敗衛冕隊伍後，我們校隊被封為全國冠軍。
senses.note: 常用被動：be crowned + 頭銜

senses.en: the top part of a tree, head, or hill
senses.pattern: the crown of a tree / the crown of the head / the crown of the hill
senses.example: Monkeys leaped from one tree [[crown]] to another, hardly ever touching the forest floor.
senses.example_zh: 猴子從一個樹冠跳到另一個樹冠，幾乎從不碰到森林的地面。

gsat.sentence: In forested areas with thick tree [[crowns]], there is intense struggle for these resources.
Gaps in the treetops resulting from [[crown]] shyness may allow trees to increase their exposure to light and enhance photosynthesis.

senses.en: to attract and keep someone's attention or interest
senses.pattern: engage sb's attention / engage sb's interest / engage the audience
senses.example: A good science teacher knows how to [[engage]] students' interest with simple experiments.
senses.example_zh: 好的自然科老師懂得用簡單的實驗吸引學生的興趣。
senses.note: 形容詞 engaging：吸引人的、迷人的

senses.en: to hire someone to do a particular job
senses.pattern: engage a lawyer / engage a tutor / engage sb as a guide / engage the services of
senses.example: The film crew [[engaged]] a local guide to lead them through the mountain villages.
senses.example_zh: 劇組聘用了一位當地嚮導，帶他們走訪山區的村落。

senses.en: to prefer or support one over others, sometimes unfairly
senses.pattern: favor A over B / favor a plan / favor one side
senses.example: A fair referee should never [[favor]] one team over the other during a game.
senses.example_zh: 公正的裁判在比賽中絕不該偏袒任何一隊。
senses.note: in favor of 表「贊成、支持」

senses.en: to give an advantage to someone or something
senses.pattern: favor the home team / conditions favor sth / be favored by the weather
senses.example: The strong wind [[favored]] the sailors heading south, pushing their boats along the coast.
senses.example_zh: 強風有利於往南航行的水手，推著他們的船沿海岸前進。

gsat.sentence: Korea and Japan [[favor]] animal names and China likes names of gods such as Longwang (dragon king) and Fengshen (god of the wind).
The clockwise design [[favored]] right-handed castle defenders.

senses.en: (of a business) to close because it has failed
senses.pattern: the company folded / fold after two years / be forced to fold
senses.example: The small magazine [[folded]] after only a year because it could not attract enough readers.
senses.example_zh: 這家小雜誌社因為吸引不到足夠的讀者，才成立一年就倒閉了。

senses.en: to cross your arms over your chest
senses.pattern: fold your arms / with arms folded / fold your hands
senses.example: The coach [[folded]] his arms and watched silently as the players argued about the missed goal.
senses.example_zh: 教練雙臂交叉，默默看著球員為那記沒進的球爭論。

gsat.sentence: When people feel uncomfortable or nervous, they may [[fold]] their arms across their chests as if to protect themselves.

senses.en: a very large amount of money
senses.pattern: make a fortune / cost a fortune / a small fortune / inherit a fortune
senses.example: Repairing the old temple roof cost a [[fortune]], so villagers held a fair to raise money.
senses.example_zh: 修繕老廟的屋頂花了一筆巨款，於是村民舉辦園遊會來募款。

senses.en: the good and bad things that happen to someone
senses.pattern: the fortunes of / changing fortunes / a reversal of fortune / tell sb's fortune
senses.example: The team's [[fortunes]] changed overnight when a talented young pitcher joined them in June.
senses.example_zh: 一位有天分的年輕投手在六月加入後，這支球隊的命運一夕之間改變。

gsat.sentence: The movie director adapted this year’s bestseller into a hit and made a [[fortune]].

Cartier-Bresson’s family was wealthy—his father made a [[fortune]] as a textile manufacturer—but Cartier-Bresson later joked that due to his parents’ frugal ways, it often seemed as though his family was poor.

senses.en: to suddenly stop moving because of fear or shock
senses.pattern: freeze with fear / freeze in one's tracks / freeze on stage
senses.example: When the spotlight hit her, the young singer [[froze]] and forgot the first line of the song.
senses.example_zh: 聚光燈一打在她身上，年輕的歌手就僵住了，連第一句歌詞都忘了。

senses.en: to officially prevent money being used or prices rising
senses.pattern: freeze sb's assets / freeze a bank account / freeze prices / freeze wages
senses.example: The bank [[froze]] his account after noticing several strange payments made from overseas.
senses.example_zh: 銀行發現數筆來自海外的可疑付款後，便凍結了他的帳戶。

senses.en: to understand something fully, especially something difficult
senses.pattern: grasp the meaning / grasp a concept / grasp the importance of / fail to grasp
senses.example: It took me a few minutes to [[grasp]] what the physics teacher was trying to explain.
senses.example_zh: 我花了幾分鐘才理解物理老師想解釋的內容。

senses.en: a person's understanding of a subject
senses.pattern: a good grasp of / a firm grasp of grammar / beyond one's grasp
senses.example: After living in Madrid for two years, she has a solid [[grasp]] of Spanish grammar.
senses.example_zh: 在馬德里住了兩年後，她對西班牙文法已有扎實的掌握。

senses.en: to walk in step, or walk together in protest
senses.pattern: march through the streets / march for peace / march against the war / a marching band
senses.example: Thousands of students [[marched]] through the capital to demand stronger action on climate change.
senses.example_zh: 數千名學生在首都遊行示威，要求對氣候變遷採取更有力的行動。

senses.en: the steady forward progress of something
senses.pattern: the march of time / the march of progress / the march of technology
senses.example: No one can stop the [[march]] of time, but we can decide how to spend each day.
senses.example_zh: 沒有人能阻止時間的推進，但我們可以決定如何度過每一天。

gsat.sentence: Finally, football fans seem to love the half-time activities, the [[marching]] bands, and the pretty cheerleaders.
Then, almost as if at a given signal, the group begins to [[march]] toward the colony to be raided.

senses.en: to learn something completely
senses.pattern: master a language / master a skill / master the basics
senses.example: Children who move abroad often [[master]] a new language much faster than their parents do.
senses.example_zh: 移居國外的孩子，往往比父母更快精通一種新語言。

senses.en: to manage to control a strong feeling
senses.pattern: master your fear / master your emotions / master your temper
senses.example: She took a deep breath to [[master]] her fear before stepping onto the stage.
senses.example_zh: 她深吸一口氣克服恐懼，然後才踏上舞台。

gsat.sentence: The skill of playing the glass armonica was very hard to [[master]].
He [[mastered]] the instrument and took it to parties and gatherings to play for his friends and acquaintances.

senses.en: (of a plant or animal) originally from a place
senses.pattern: be native to / native plants / native species / a native bird
senses.example: These wild lilies are [[native]] to Taiwan and can be found from the seashore to the high mountains.
senses.example_zh: 這種野百合原產於臺灣，從海邊到高山都能見到。

senses.en: a person born in a particular place
senses.pattern: a native of Tainan / a native of the island / speak like a native
senses.example: Although the chef is a [[native]] of Italy, he has run a noodle shop in Tainan for years.
senses.example_zh: 這位主廚雖然是土生土長的義大利人，卻已在臺南開麵店多年。
senses.note: a native of＋地方＝在該地出生的人

gsat.sentence: The pineapple, long a symbol of Hawaii, was not a [[native]] plant.
[[Natives]] planted the fruit across South and Central America and in the Caribbean region, where Christopher Columbus first found it.

senses.en: to obey a law, rule, or custom
senses.pattern: observe the rules / observe the law / observe the speed limit
senses.example: All swimmers must [[observe]] the safety rules posted at the entrance to the pool.
senses.example_zh: 所有泳客都必須遵守張貼在泳池入口的安全規定。

senses.en: to celebrate or mark a festival or special day
senses.pattern: observe a holiday / observe a festival / observe Christmas
senses.example: Earth Day is [[observed]] in many countries with tree planting and beach cleanups.
senses.example_zh: 許多國家以植樹和淨灘活動來慶祝世界地球日。

senses.en: to make a remark about something you have noticed
senses.pattern: observe that… / as sb once observed / he observed dryly
senses.example: “You seem much happier since you changed schools,” my aunt [[observed]] over dinner.
senses.example_zh: 「你轉學之後好像快樂多了。」阿姨吃晚餐時這麼說。
senses.note: 名詞 observation 可指「評論」

gsat.sentence: Proper social behavior must be [[observed]] by prom-goers.
Since then, World Hello Day—November 21st of every year—has been [[observed]] by people in 180 countries.

senses.en: (of a number) that cannot be divided exactly by two
senses.pattern: odd numbers / odd and even / odd-numbered pages
senses.example: Houses on the left side of this street all have [[odd]] numbers, such as 7 and 9.
senses.example_zh: 這條街左側的房子門牌都是奇數號，例如七號和九號。

senses.en: happening or done occasionally; not regular
senses.pattern: odd jobs / at odd moments / the odd mistake
senses.example: During the summer, Ben earned pocket money by doing [[odd]] jobs for his neighbors.
senses.example_zh: 暑假期間，班替鄰居做些零星的雜工來賺零用錢。

senses.en: to carry out a task, duty, or operation
senses.pattern: perform an operation / perform a task / perform an experiment / perform one's duties
senses.example: The surgeon [[performed]] a six-hour operation to repair the boy's damaged heart.
senses.example_zh: 外科醫師執行了長達六小時的手術，修補男孩受損的心臟。

senses.en: to work or do something well or badly
senses.pattern: perform well / perform poorly / perform under pressure / perform better than expected
senses.example: Students who get enough sleep tend to [[perform]] better on tests than those who stay up late.
senses.example_zh: 睡眠充足的學生考試表現往往比熬夜的學生好。

gsat.sentence: Heroes are selfless people who [[perform]] extraordinary acts.
To [[perform]] well academically at school.

senses.en: done on a small scale as a test
senses.pattern: a pilot project / a pilot program / a pilot study / a pilot scheme
senses.example: The [[pilot]] study involved only fifty patients, so the doctors plan a much larger trial next year.
senses.example_zh: 這項試驗性的研究只有五十名病患參與，因此醫生們計畫明年進行規模大得多的試驗。

senses.en: to test a new idea on a small scale
senses.pattern: pilot a scheme / pilot a new course / be piloted in schools
senses.example: The bike-sharing service was first [[piloted]] in two districts and later expanded to the whole city.
senses.example_zh: 這項共享單車服務先在兩個行政區試辦，後來才擴大到全市。

senses.en: a person who guides ships into a harbor
senses.pattern: a marine pilot / a harbor pilot / take a pilot on board
senses.example: A local [[pilot]] climbed aboard to guide the huge cargo ship safely through the narrow harbor entrance.
senses.example_zh: 一位當地的領航員登船，引導這艘巨型貨輪安全通過狹窄的港口入口。

gsat.sentence: The [[pilot]] project dedicated to developing the cactus biogas generator began in the south of Mexico City.
This captain is called a marine [[pilot]].

senses.en: to force someone or something into a worse state
senses.pattern: be reduced to tears / be reduced to begging / reduce sth to ashes / be reduced to rubble
senses.example: After losing his job, the proud engineer was [[reduced]] to borrowing money from old friends.
senses.example_zh: 失業之後，這位自尊心很強的工程師淪落到得向老朋友借錢度日。
senses.note: 常用被動 be reduced to + N/V-ing

senses.en: a dead body; what is left of old buildings
senses.pattern: human remains / the remains of a temple / ancient remains
senses.example: Visitors can still see the [[remains]] of the old city wall behind the train station.
senses.example_zh: 遊客仍可在火車站後方看到舊城牆的遺跡。

senses.en: to still need to be done or dealt with
senses.pattern: it remains to be seen / much remains to be done / questions remain
senses.example: It [[remains]] to be seen whether the new rule will actually reduce traffic accidents.
senses.example_zh: 新規定是否真能減少交通事故，仍有待觀察。

gsat.sentence: Inside the burial box were the [[remains]] of the deceased.

senses.en: to be equal to or amount to something
senses.pattern: represent an increase of / represent a major change / represent a threat / represent a step forward
senses.example: Sales of electric scooters now [[represent]] nearly a third of the city's scooter market.
senses.example_zh: 電動機車的銷量目前相當於全市機車市場的近三分之一。

senses.en: to show or describe someone or something in a particular way
senses.pattern: represent sb as / be represented as / represent sth in a painting
senses.example: The novel [[represents]] the king as a lonely old man rather than a cruel ruler.
senses.example_zh: 這部小說把國王描繪成一位孤獨的老人，而不是殘暴的統治者。

gsat.sentence: Which of the following pictures best [[represents]] the image of a typical Maasai warrior?

senses.en: a supply of something kept for future use
senses.pattern: oil reserves / fat reserves / keep sth in reserve / foreign exchange reserves
senses.example: The country keeps large [[reserves]] of oil in case of an emergency.
senses.example_zh: 該國保有大量的石油儲備，以備緊急之需。

senses.en: an area of land where wildlife is protected
senses.pattern: a nature reserve / a wildlife reserve / a forest reserve
senses.example: Visitors to the wildlife [[reserve]] are not allowed to feed the animals.
senses.example_zh: 野生動物保護區的遊客不得餵食動物。

gsat.sentence: The Japanese used their rubber [[reserves]] from the war to mass-produce the simplest Japanese footwear.
Sitting for too long slows down the body’s metabolism and the way enzymes break down our fat [[reserves]], raising both blood sugar levels and blood pressure.

senses.en: a tool with a toothed blade for cutting wood
senses.pattern: a hand saw / an electric saw / cut wood with a saw
senses.example: Dad used a [[saw]] to cut the fallen branch into pieces small enough to carry.
senses.example_zh: 爸爸用鋸子把掉落的樹枝鋸成搬得動的小段。

senses.en: to cut something with a saw
senses.pattern: saw wood / saw a board in half / saw off a branch / saw through a log
senses.example: The carpenter carefully [[sawed]] the board in half before nailing the two pieces together.
senses.example_zh: 木匠小心地把木板鋸成兩半，再把兩塊釘在一起。

senses.en: to fall to a lower level; to become sad
senses.pattern: sb's heart sinks / sink to a record low / sink into despair / prices sink
senses.example: My heart [[sank]] when I saw the long line of people waiting outside the ticket office.
senses.example_zh: 看到售票處外大排長龍，我的心頓時一沉，心情低落下來。

senses.en: to put a lot of money into a business or project
senses.pattern: sink money into sth / sink one's savings into sth / sink millions into sth
senses.example: The couple [[sank]] all their savings into a small café that closed within a year.
senses.example_zh: 這對夫妻把所有積蓄都投入一家小咖啡館，結果不到一年就關門了。

senses.en: a building in which horses are kept
senses.pattern: a riding stable / in the stable / clean the stables
senses.example: Every morning before school, Lily feeds the horses and cleans the [[stable]].
senses.example_zh: 每天早上上學前，莉莉都會餵馬並打掃馬廄。

senses.en: a legal case brought to a court
senses.pattern: file a suit / bring a suit against / a civil suit
senses.example: Three former workers filed a [[suit]] against the factory, claiming that it had never paid them overtime.
senses.example_zh: 三名前員工對工廠提起訴訟，聲稱工廠從未付過加班費。

senses.en: to be right, convenient, or suitable for someone or something
senses.pattern: suit one's needs / be well suited to / suit sb's taste
senses.example: The quiet seaside town is well [[suited]] to travelers who want to escape crowded tourist spots.
senses.example_zh: 這座寧靜的海濱小鎮很適合想避開擁擠景點的旅客。

gsat.sentence: Is it a good idea to keep animals in sites not [[suited]] to them?
The moral lesson is “First identify your strengths, and then change the playing field to [[suit]] them.”

senses.en: a person of higher rank or position
senses.pattern: one's immediate superior / report to a superior / obey one's superiors
senses.example: Before making such a big decision, you had better discuss it with your [[superior]].
senses.example_zh: 做這麼重大的決定之前，你最好先和上司討論。

senses.en: acting as if you are better than others
senses.pattern: a superior smile / a superior tone / a superior attitude / act superior
senses.example: His [[superior]] tone made the new members feel that their opinions did not matter.
senses.example_zh: 他高傲的語氣讓新成員覺得自己的意見無足輕重。

senses.en: to use rude or offensive language
senses.pattern: swear at sb / swear loudly / stop swearing
senses.example: The player was sent off the field for [[swearing]] at the referee during the match.
senses.example_zh: 那名球員因在比賽中咒罵裁判而被罰出場。

senses.en: a noticeable change in opinion or mood
senses.pattern: mood swings / a swing in public opinion / a sharp swing / a swing toward
senses.example: Teenagers often experience sudden mood [[swings]] that even they themselves cannot explain.
senses.example_zh: 青少年常會出現突如其來的情緒波動，連他們自己也無法解釋。

senses.en: to change, or make something change, quickly
senses.pattern: swing from A to B / swing in sb's favor / swing the vote / swing the decision
senses.example: Public opinion can [[swing]] quickly once people see how a new policy affects their daily lives.
senses.example_zh: 一旦民眾看到新政策如何影響日常生活，輿論可能很快就會轉向。

senses.en: a person or people with a natural ability
senses.pattern: attract top talent / young talent / local talent / a talent scout
senses.example: Tech companies offer high salaries and flexible hours to attract young [[talent]] from around the world.
senses.example_zh: 科技公司提供高薪和彈性工時，以吸引來自世界各地的年輕人才。
senses.note: 泛指人才時多作不可數名詞

gsat.sentence: Interviewer: You’re the older brother of Rahm, the mayor of Chicago, and Ari, an extremely successful [[talent]] agent.

senses.en: a device that controls the flow of water
senses.pattern: turn on the tap / turn off the tap / tap water / a dripping tap
senses.example: Remember to turn off the [[tap]] while you are brushing your teeth to save water.
senses.example_zh: 刷牙時記得關掉水龍頭，以節約用水。
senses.note: 美式常用 faucet；tap water＝自來水

senses.en: to make use of a resource or supply
senses.pattern: tap natural resources / tap a new market / tap sb's talent
senses.example: The island hopes to [[tap]] its strong ocean winds to produce clean electricity.
senses.example_zh: 這座島嶼希望利用強勁的海風來生產乾淨的電力。

gsat.sentence: Many people like to drink bottled water because they feel that [[tap]] water may not be safe, but is bottled water really any better?

senses.en: an area of knowledge, activity, or experience
senses.pattern: unfamiliar territory / uncharted territory / familiar territory / new territory
senses.example: Teaching online was unfamiliar [[territory]] for most of the teachers, so they needed extra training.
senses.example_zh: 線上教學對大多數老師來說是陌生的領域，所以他們需要額外的訓練。

senses.en: an area that an animal defends as its own
senses.pattern: mark its territory / defend its territory / establish a territory
senses.example: A male tiger marks its [[territory]] by scratching trees and will attack any rival that enters.
senses.example_zh: 公老虎會抓樹幹來標示自己的地盤，並攻擊任何闖入的對手。

gsat.sentence: Male howler monkeys use their loud voices to fight for food, mates, or [[territory]].

senses.en: (of time or money) limited, with little to spare
senses.pattern: a tight schedule / a tight budget / a tight deadline / money is tight
senses.example: Money was [[tight]] that year, so the family canceled their trip and spent the holidays at home.
senses.example_zh: 那一年家裡經濟吃緊，所以全家取消旅行，在家過節。

senses.en: strictly controlled; very firm
senses.pattern: tight security / tight control / keep a tight grip on sth
senses.example: Security was [[tight]] at the stadium, with every bag checked before fans could enter.
senses.example_zh: 體育場的維安十分嚴密，球迷入場前每個包包都要檢查。
senses.note: a tight game 指比數接近的比賽

gsat.sentence: The mayor has such a [[tight]] schedule that it takes weeks to arrange an interview with her.
Steve has several meetings to attend every day; therefore, he has to work on a very [[tight]] schedule.

senses.en: an idea of the future; the ability to plan it wisely
senses.pattern: a leader with vision / a clear vision / a vision of the future / share a vision
senses.example: The founder had a clear [[vision]] of a school where every child could learn at their own pace.
senses.example_zh: 創辦人有個清楚的願景：一所讓每個孩子都能照自己步調學習的學校。

senses.en: a picture in your mind or a dream
senses.pattern: have a vision of / have visions of / see sth in a vision
senses.example: The night before the exam, he had [[visions]] of himself staring at a blank answer sheet.
senses.example_zh: 考試前一晚，他腦中浮現自己盯著空白答案卷的景象。

gsat.sentence: In 1977, he bought a piece of rocky wasteland with the [[vision]] of growing trees on it.
Camake said, “They told me afterward that through our performance, they had a [[vision]] of our country, our village, without having to visit it.

senses.en: the amount of space something fills or contains
senses.pattern: the volume of a cube / the volume of water / by volume
senses.example: To calculate the [[volume]] of the box, multiply its length, width, and height.
senses.example_zh: 要計算這個盒子的體積，把它的長、寬、高相乘即可。

senses.en: the amount of something, especially when large
senses.pattern: the volume of traffic / sales volume / a high volume of
senses.example: The [[volume]] of traffic on this highway doubles during the Lunar New Year holiday.
senses.example_zh: 春節假期期間，這條高速公路的車流量會增加一倍。

senses.en: one book in a series or set
senses.pattern: the first volume / volume two / a three-volume set
senses.example: The second [[volume]] of the novel picks up the story ten years after the first one ends.
senses.example_zh: 這部小說的第二冊從第一冊結束的十年後接續故事。

quiz.stem: Drivers who fail to ______ the speed limit near schools will be fined heavily under the new traffic law.
quiz.explain_zh: observe＝遵守（規定）。在學校附近不遵守速限的駕駛將被重罰。

quiz.stem: Throughout her career, the scientist ______ the rights of women in research, speaking at conferences and urging universities to hire more female professors.
quiz.explain_zh: champion＝擁護、捍衛。這位科學家一生為女性研究人員的權益發聲。

quiz.stem: The founder of the online bookstore was a woman of great ______, who predicted decades ago that people would one day shop from their phones.
quiz.explain_zh: vision＝遠見。創辦人很有遠見，數十年前就預測到手機購物。

quiz.stem: The airport opened a third terminal to handle the growing ______ of passengers, which had doubled in just ten years.
quiz.explain_zh: volume＝（數）量。機場啟用第三航廈，以應付十年內倍增的旅客量。

quiz.stem: Unable to compete with large online stores, the small bookshop near our school finally ______ last month after forty years in business.
quiz.explain_zh: fold＝倒閉、停業。小書店不敵大型網路商店，上個月結束營業。

quiz.stem: Scientists digging in the desert discovered the ______ of a dinosaur that had lived more than seventy million years ago.
quiz.explain_zh: remain＝（複數 remains）遺骸。科學家在沙漠中挖到七千多萬年前的恐龍遺骸。

quiz.stem: Camels can go for weeks without food in the desert because they carry large fat ______ in their humps and slowly turn them into energy.
quiz.explain_zh: reserve＝儲備（量）。駱駝在駝峰儲存大量脂肪，可慢慢轉化為能量。

quiz.stem: Before introducing the four-day school week nationwide, the ministry ran a ______ program in twenty schools to see how students and teachers would respond.
quiz.explain_zh: pilot＝試辦的。教育部先在二十所學校試辦，觀察師生反應後再全國實施。

quiz.stem: The kiwi, a flightless bird ______ to New Zealand, is now threatened by cats, dogs, and other animals that were brought to the islands by settlers.
quiz.explain_zh: native＝原產於…的。奇異鳥原產於紐西蘭，如今受外來動物威脅。

quiz.stem: Whenever the teacher asks him to speak in front of the whole class, Kevin ______ and cannot say a single word.
quiz.explain_zh: freeze＝（因緊張、恐懼）僵住。Kevin 一被要求在全班面前說話就僵住，說不出話。
